corrections.reason: The printed glyph in line 29 is clearly ቀናኢ with ኢ (matching line 33 below), not ዒ.

Both visual inspection of the straight right leg of ከ and Classical Ge'ez grammar (perfective verb ከፈሎ 'he allotted/gave to him', glossed in lines 5–6 as የሰጠው ሲሆን / ያደለው ሲሆን) confirm ወከፈሎ rather than ወክፈሎ.
The printed initial character is labialized ጐ (ጐኑ), not 7th-order ጎ.
